sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 6 月 26 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：MSFT、CXMT、MU、SPCX、SPY。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • U.S. military launched another airstrike on Iran after Friday’s close: In response to Thursday’s Iranian drone attack on the Singapore-flagged cargo ship Ever Lovely (in violation of the Strait of Hormuz navigation MoU signed last week), 6 U.S. military aircraft struck 4 missile, drone, and radar sites along Iran’s coast. The strike was deliberately announced after the close, and oil prices and indices showed almost no reaction. During Friday’s regular session, SPY closed at $732.14 (-0.16%), QQQ at $704.94 (-1.59%), DIA at $517.29 (-0.38%), and IWM at $297.69 (-0.39%). This week, SPY was down about -2% and QQQ about -4%, marking the first 5-day losing streak of the year.
  • Memory/semiconductors suffered a second bloodbath: On Friday, WDC plunged -14.3% ($578.52), SNDK -10.7% ($2084.54), and MU -7.05% ($1129.73), wiping out in two days the gains following MU’s explosive Wednesday earnings report (revenue of about $41.4 billion, adjusted EPS of about $25). NVDA fell -2% ($191.88), breaking below $200. CRDO also sold off further due to the Russell semiconductor index adjustment.
  • Apple seeks to procure memory chips from China’s CXMT: FT reported on Friday/Saturday that Apple is lobbying the government to approve DRAM purchases from CXMT, which has been placed on the Pentagon’s “Chinese military companies list,” in order to lower costs (Apple had previously raised MacBook/iPad prices by 20% due to rising memory prices). The community is sharply divided over whether this is bearish for MU.
  • SpaceX (SPCX) to be added to the Nasdaq 100 on July 7: Only about 15 trading days after its IPO, this is the fastest inclusion in history. JPMorgan estimates about $4.3 billion in passive inflows. SPCX closed Friday at $152.71 (-0.11%); spreads on its $25 billion of bonds widened sharply in the secondary market, with mark-to-market losses of about $305 million.
  • Software rotation leader MSFT surged against the market: MSFT +5.54% ($371.94), with reports after hours of a massive block trade of about 57 million shares; Michael Burry was reported to have bought long-dated MSFT calls, added to JD/ADBE, and reduced PLTR shorts.
  • Israel-Lebanon signed a framework agreement: Hezbollah was not a signatory, and the community broadly believes it will not last.
  • SPY spiked down to 716.58 near Friday’s close before instantly rebounding, extending the debate over “glitch / manipulation / insider trading.”

社区氛围：整体疲惫不堪，麻木不仁，悲观情绪，但充满讽刺和黑色幽默——这是一个典型的“周末战争”低容量垃圾帖之夜。绝大多数用户对战争再次爆发没有任何反应。主流剧本是“周日晚上或周一开场前再次假停火，然后回到独立日”。少数顽固的空头和满载记忆的多头在废墟中互相厮杀，恐慌与麻木交织在一起。

恐惧/贪婪：恐惧区域（评论将市场描述为“在极度恐惧中收盘”），但它更接近于“投降性麻木”而不是严重恐慌。一个突出的现象是周末帖子流量创下历史新低，许多人将其解释为“爆掉的账户太多，没有人有心情发帖”。

情绪与现实：社区情绪远比实际市场悲观——SPY 距 ATH 还不到 4%，道指仍高于 50,000 点，但评论区却充斥着账户爆仓、借贷、退出交易的故事。这种“指数温和、个股流失”之间的分化源于 WSB 头寸高度集中在遭受重创的高贝塔内存/半导体公司。

股票行情指示器提及牛/熊情绪核心视图摘要
